ingestion.description: Nightly: finds a real, verifiable UK hedge-care YouTube video (or written source) not yet covered, and creates a video-companion-led How-To article for each, pairing the video with Bridge/Nailbourne-valley species, timing and conservation-area specifics. Morning: audits the full site, including structural compliance with the video-companion house style and dead-video-embed checks.
ingestion.structuralAngleNote: Every article is built around one real, embedded UK hedge-care video, credited to its creator, then extended with what the video doesn't cover: North Downs chalk vs Nailbourne-valley frost-pocket species choice, Bifrons Park Conservation Area rules, nesting law. This is the ring-wide differentiator versus chatham (timeline-led), canterbury (checklist-first), broadstairs (procedural-first), gravesend (regulation-first) and the other sister sites.
categories: Species-specific pruning technique (hornbeam, beech, yew, hawthorn)
Staged reduction of overgrown Leylandii/laurel screens
Planting a new hedge on North Downs chalk vs valley-floor ground
High-hedge complaint process and neighbour law
Box blight and box tree moth management
